headword: {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}

definitions.gloss: stretching exercises; flexibility exercises; calisthenics for flexibility
definitions.explanation: Physical exercises designed to increase the body's flexibility and range of motion, typically involving bending, reaching, and holding stretched positions.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}をしている。
examples.english: I do stretching exercises every morning.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}の{前|まえ}には{柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}で{体|からだ}をほぐしましょう。
examples.english: Let's loosen up with stretching exercises before working out.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}ると{体|からだ}が{硬|かた}くなりがちだが、{毎日|まいにち}{柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}を{続|つづ}ければ{怪我|けが}の{予防|よぼう}にもなる。
examples.english: As you age, your body tends to become stiff, but continuing stretching exercises every day can also help prevent injuries.

notes:
A compound of {柔軟|じゅうなん} (flexible, supple) and {体操|たいそう} (gymnastics, exercises). This is the traditional Japanese term for stretching exercises. While the English loanword ストレッチ is now widely used, {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう} remains common in school PE classes and among older generations.

In Japanese schools, students typically do {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう} as part of {体育|たいいく} (physical education). Flexibility is often tested in fitness assessments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}をする: to do stretching exercises
- {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}で{体|からだ}をほぐす: to loosen up the body with stretching
- {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}を{続|つづ}ける: to keep up stretching exercises

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ストレッチ: stretching — the modern loanword, now more common in gyms and fitness contexts
- {準備運動|じゅんびうんどう}: warm-up exercises — broader term including light jogging and other warm-up activities, not just stretching
- {体操|たいそう}: gymnastics; exercises — the general term for physical exercises and calisthenics
- ヨガ: yoga — includes stretching but also breathing and meditation
